answer: Every agent identity must clear a TWIC-style port credential: the Transportation Security Administration runs an FBI fingerprint threat assessment before issuing the card, so one set of prints unlocks one identity and the 25.25 fee renews only every five years. A forger cannot forge clean prints or a blank criminal record, and every fake dies at the gate — the reader demands a live fingerprint match, the timber barrier stays down, the jade light never turns green, and security logs the attempt for the FBI.
